name: GURRIERS at M.Ou.Co., Porto 2026
description: Gurriers, an Irish band, will perform their new noise-rock work in Porto, following their debut album, Come and See. This concert is part of the Primavera Tours program, bringing the festival spirit to venues throughout the year.
longDescription:
Gurriers, an Irish band, is set to perform their new noise-rock work in Porto. This concert follows the release of their debut album, Come and See, and marks their first appearance in the city.

The event is scheduled for November 7, 2026, at M.Ou.Co. in Porto. Doors open at 20:00, with the concert starting at 21:00. This performance is part of the Primavera Tours, a series of concerts that extends the Primavera Sound festival experience throughout the year.

Attendees can get a 7% discount on general tickets by paying with Revolut Pay. Minors under 16 years old are permitted to enter if accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

longDescriptionPt:

O evento está marcado para 7 de novembro de 2026, no M.Ou.Co. no Porto. As portas abrem às 20:00, com o concerto a começar às 21:00. Esta atuação faz parte do Primavera Tours, uma série de concertos que prolonga a experiência do festival Primavera Sound ao longo do ano.

Quem for pode ter um desconto de 7% nos bilhetes gerais ao pagar com Revolut Pay. Menores de 16 anos podem entrar se forem acompanhados por um pai, mãe ou tutor legal.
